additional_conditions: CC0 is the verified right for the original Movebank Data Repository data packages, not an automatic assertion about ownership/redistribution of separately generated analytical output ZIPs with original bat tags.
Movebank guidance distinguishes license from scientific attribution, original source-author communication, coauthorship customs and possible location/tag sensitivity.
The original artifacts' expiration is December 28–31, 2026; no permanent right-cleared steward-controlled ID archive has been created.
Dataset context summaries and titles are from original DOI abstracts, not newly observed task labels for any V/S/I included bat.
All ecological mechanisms and task-allocations proposed from source abstracts remain untested by current smoothed-height analysis.
